added: packages/task-graph (@sos-2/task-graph): the durable task graph — TaskNode records carrying a MISSION REFERENCE and an AUTHORITY REFERENCE on EVERY task (pinned by tests: node inputs without either are typed rejections; scans verify both references on every node view, every durable P2 TaskRecord and every task-graph observation event), owned-path scopes with tree-discipline disjointness (concurrent assignment only onto DISJOINT scopes — a collision is a typed AssignmentDeniedError SCOPE_COLLISION naming the first colliding pair, never a silent overlap), validated acyclic dependencies (orphaned references and cycles are typed structure errors BEFORE the first write), the typed six-state machine (PENDING/RUNNING/PAUSED/CANCELLED/COMPLETED/FAILED with named-rule transition errors; COMPLETED is verification-gated; FAILED carries an explicit RETRYABLE/TERMINAL recovery decision — recovery marks the task retryable, never silently done), typed assignment + handoff records (task, lane 1..3, worker ref, lease ref; the handoff carries the authority reference + the exact workspace revision), the checkpoint chain (a crashed worker resumes from its last checkpoint, not from zero), workspace-revision pinning, the cost envelope, unresolved uncertainty retention and the final verification record ref. The full section 6 task-durability field list of spec/productization-execution-architecture.md is representable FIELD-FOR-FIELD (pinned by the acceptance structure suite): every node IS one P2 TaskRecord — the node snapshot serializes into the record's plan field (VERBATIM persistence: the store never redefines the graph's shapes; every section 6 field maps natively onto the P2 record shape). Crash safety is STRUCTURAL: all writes are CAS-guarded read-modify-writes (no partial writes), every mutation is observed in the replay-protected observation boundary with deterministic namespaced ids (graph-obs:), and invariant scans (G1..G8: mission+authority references, dependency resolution + acyclicity, concurrent scope disjointness, lane exclusivity, checkpoint-chain integrity, FAILED-requires-recovery, COMPLETED-requires-verification, ask uniqueness) run after every tick and are pinned across the crash/body-loss journeys. Identity discipline: task ids are caller-supplied RUNTIME identifiers (no local identity minting; spine-shaped ids rejected loudly through the @sos-2/runtime-contracts guard).

packages/reasoning-broker (@sos-2/reasoning-broker): the NON-AUTHORITATIVE reasoning plane — the ReasoningProviderPort (an injectable port: providers are replaceable reasoning mechanisms, never authorities; the port carries NO authority fields). THE DEFAULT MANAGED PROVIDER IS ALWAYS PRESENT with zero user configuration (a user NEVER needs to connect a personal LLM to start — pinned: full journeys complete with zero BYO providers; a registered-but-unconnected BYO slot is honestly ineligible). OPTIONAL bring-your-own adapters share the exact port shape and report honest NOT_YET_CONNECTED statuses until connected (availability never fabricated; connection attaches real providers later without contract change). Provider routing is capability/cost/context driven and every selection is a TYPED, RECORDED RoutingDecision (auditable considered-list naming every provider's eligibility and reason; connected-and-eligible BYO preferred, the managed default the always-eligible fallback; an honestly-unavailable selected provider falls back to the managed default with the fallback RECORDED). Model/version provenance rides EVERY output (provider identity + kind + model + version + the routing decision id + the EXPLICIT simulated marker — the P8 provenance discipline). ALL broker output is typed NonAuthoritativeAnalysis carrying the STRUCTURAL non_authoritative:true marker (validated — output without the marker is a typed provenance violation; pinned by scans: no authority or verification field is ever populated from broker output). Deterministic reference providers are SIMULATED with explicit markers; zero real network in src; analysis and routing ids are content-derived (deterministic, never minted).

packages/worker-runtime (@sos-2/worker-runtime): the worker-side execution runtime — the contract a WORKER fulfils while executing an assigned task through the P5 harness: section 9 session establishment through the contract itself (createTask on a first run, resumeTask on a retry — a replacement body ADOPTS the task with a fresh bounded environment and the worker honestly restarts from zero when the adoption reports no recovered state), §9 operations dispatched through the execution fabric's uniform gates, and CAPABILITY-CHECKED calls: every operation step is pre-checked against the body's BINDING section 3 advertisement through the harness contract's own isOperationAdvertised map BEFORE dispatch — an unadvertised operation is a typed CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED failure naming the operation, never a silent failure, never a surprise dispatch. CHECKPOINT DISCIPLINE: checkpoint steps record durable checkpoints through the fabric's recordCheckpoint and chain them into the task graph (a crashed worker resumes from the last checkpoint; the WorkerResult carries resumed_from_checkpoint). Typed failure classification of fabric denials (lease codes -> BODY_LOST; authority codes -> AUTHORITY_GAP; advertisement -> CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED). RESULT EMISSION: typed WorkerResult records with DURABLE evidence refs (fabric observation ids + the fabric-minted content-addressed artifact ids — never fabricated, never the body's payload ids), the EXACT workspace revision (the git commit ref; never defaulted), full provenance (worker + body/harness runtime identities + provider identity/model/version when the reasoning broker participated) and an HONEST status — a completion REPORT never certifies mission success (section 10). The reference implementation is deterministic and in-process (injected clock/fabric/broker/graph/stores); simulated crashes are explicit deterministic injections carrying the honest simulated marker; zero real process spawning in library code.

packages/orchestrator (@sos-2/orchestrator): the governed control loop of the persistent Spirit over the merged P2 live-store records and the P5 execution fabric (the section 2 topology: the orchestrator sits beside System State and Observation, above the Body Broker — part of the SPIRIT control loop, never a body, never an authority mint). MISSION-AWARE DECOMPOSITION: a Mission (consumed from @sos-2/mission) decomposes into the durable task graph — decomposition is a TYPED RECORD (inputs, plan, rationale) routed through the reasoning broker as NON-AUTHORITATIVE input (broker_input carries the analysis ids + non_authoritative:true + the simulated marker), while the task graph itself is authoritative structure built by DETERMINISTIC CODE (scopes, dependencies and step programs are fixed deterministic functions of the mission content; the broker's proposals only inform titles). Up to THREE concurrent worker lanes with assignment only onto DISJOINT owned-path scopes (typed SCOPE_COLLISION denial recorded on the tick, never silent overlap) and free-lane discipline (LANE_EXHAUSTED waits); retry dispatch prefers the task's prior body (the true resume-from-checkpoint path). PAUSE/RESUME/CANCEL are first-class section 9 operations with durable state transitions (the fabric's contract-shaped lifecycle + the graph's typed adoption). ASK ESCALATION through @sos-2/ask's AskQueue via the merged golden workflow (decision engine evaluate -> ASK decision record -> composeAskContent -> createAskRequest -> first-class queue entry): ASK IS A SUCCESS STATE — uncertainty and authority gaps escalate as first-class records and the task parks (durable status AWAITING_INPUT; the section 9 surface refuses it; resolution returns it to PAUSED for resume), never an exception class, never a silent bypass (pinned). WORKER RESULT INGESTION routes every completion REPORT to the INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION PORT (ReferenceIndependentVerifier: verdicts derive from durable evidence ONLY — the observation-event store + the task record's artifacts; C1..C6 deterministic checks; presenting a broker analysis id as verification evidence is a typed SilentBypassViolationError naming the rule and field): the VERIFICATION RECORD GATES the COMPLETED transition (assertVerificationGatesCompletion; a REJECTED verdict fails closed into a typed VERIFICATION_REJECTED failure) — a worker reporting completion NEVER certifies mission success (no self-approval; pinned). THE ARCHITECT ROLE IS A GOVERNED CONTROL FUNCTION: typed ArchitectGateRecord for consequential transitions (MERGE/PROMOTE/DEPLOY/MISSION_COMPLETION) carrying the authority reference acted under — the gate is RECORDED (append-only decision log), BOUNDED (approves only under stored, evaluated authority) and CANNOT MINT AUTHORITY (unresolvable/expired/revoked references are typed ArchitectGateViolationError naming the rule and field; a forged gate record authorizes nothing — pinned). Mission completion itself refuses to run without all tasks verification-gated COMPLETED and a governed gate record. The control loop runs one deterministic tick at a time (recovery -> dispatch -> execute -> ingest -> invariant scan; a failing scan is a typed violation) on the host's injected tick source.

apps/orchestrator (@sos-2/orchestrator-host): the composition root — plain Node + TypeScript (repo-standard ESM + tsc, no vendor framework; the apps/api + apps/worker-runtimes precedent) assembling the in-memory durable P2 stores, the Body Broker with the P8 reference cloud bodies registered (four bodies: three lanes + a recovery spare), the Execution Fabric, the durable Task Graph, the Reasoning Broker (managed default always present), the Worker Runtime, the Independent Verifier, the AskQueue and the ArchitectGate into the Spirit Orchestrator. The single impure boundary is the documented system-clock module (the only Date.now in the P6-owned sources — exempted by the determinism scans; the deterministic demo deliberately runs on a fixed ManualClock instead). The orchestrator loop runs on an INJECTED TICK SOURCE (FiniteTickSource — bounded, no ambient timers). The demo main executes a deterministic three-lane journey end-to-end: mission -> decomposition -> 3 concurrent lanes on disjoint owned-path scopes -> crash + recovery of one lane (explicit deterministic simulated crash injection) -> verification-gated completion -> architect-gated mission completion -> HONEST REPORT with explicit simulated markers (demo state is never presented as live state).

tests/orchestration (@sos-2/orchestration-contracts): the SIX PINNED acceptance suites + determinism/structure suites. (1) Concurrency: three lanes dispatch onto disjoint owned paths in one tick (three distinct lanes, handoffs carrying authority + revision) and a colliding assignment is a typed SCOPE_COLLISION denial naming the rule (the colliding task never runs; the graph stays valid); at most three lanes exist (the fourth waits, LANE_EXHAUSTED recorded). (2) Mission/authority: every task in every journey carries BOTH references — scan-pinned across node views, durable P2 TaskRecords, graph observation events and handoffs; node inputs without either reference are typed rejections. (3) Non-authoritative reasoning: every broker output validates with the structural marker + full provenance; NO verification record evidence references broker output (scans across the whole journey's authority and verification surfaces); presenting a broker analysis id as verification evidence is a typed violation naming the rule and field; an analysis without the marker is a typed provenance violation; the ask-escalation path consumes decision records + grants, never broker output. (4) Managed default: a full three-lane journey completes with ZERO BYO providers configured; a registered-but-NOT_CONNECTED BYO slot is honestly ineligible and never blocks the journey. (5) Crash safety: a mid-journey worker crash leaves the graph structurally valid, the crashed task FAILED/RETRYABLE with a surviving checkpoint chain, and the full journey recovers (retry from checkpoint, verification-gated completion); body loss is a typed BODY_LOST failure with the lease denial code and the task recovers; a rejected verification fails closed (no task is ever silently completed). (6) No silent bypass: forged gate records, unresolvable/expired/revoked authority references and premature mission completion are typed violations naming the rule and field; ASK escalations land in the AskQueue as FIRST-CLASS records (pending entry, AskRequest artifact, origin decision record, first-class resolution through the merged queue; a non-parked resolution is a typed violation; a parked task refuses section 9 execution). (7) Determinism + structure: journeys are byte-reproducible (acceptance world + the app demo); the full section 6 field list is representable field-for-field on every durable task record (completed tasks pin verified records, exact revisions, checkpoints and artifacts); structural scans (comment-stripping, the P5 precedent) pin no Date.now/Math.random/fetch/process.env/setTimeout/setInterval/child_process in the owned package sources and the app source except the documented system-clock boundary; imports are restricted to merged + P6-owned workspace packages (unmerged siblings never referenced); the six owned packages declare ZERO external dependencies (workspace:* links + the repository's existing toolchain only, already resolved by the base lockfile). The repository's fixed vitest seed (424242) throughout.
